## Citation system

The project uses one bibliography, [reference.bib](reference.bib), for the website and Word report. Citations link to formatted entries on each page. The catalog below includes all records; research claims cite the relevant source at the point of use. The singular filename follows the user's request; Module 1 suggests the equivalent name `references.bib` [@ad688m1].

## Research source boundaries

The reconstruction uses @goindani2017, with its methods and numerical tables checked against the supplied PDF. The 2018 article by @chern2018 is separate related work; its random-forest results must not be attributed to the original SVM/GBDT paper. The five-source review appears in the [research introduction](introduction.qmd).

| Original paper content | Source locator in Goindani et al. (2017) |
|---|---|
| Motivation and normalization problem | Abstract and Section I |
| Collection and class distribution | Section II, Tables I–II |
| Title and name features | Section III-A, equations 1–6, Table III |
| Models and class penalties | Section III-B |
| Disagreement review | Section IV-A |
| Utility definitions | Section IV-B, equations 7–9 |
| Classification and utility results | Tables IV–V |
| Ablation and error types | Tables VI–VII |
| Limitations | Sections V–VII |

The Census pages establish the historical sector labels [@census2017transport; @census2017health]. The 2022 manual anchors the current scope [@naics2022]. Neither provides evidence of current career prospects.

## Dataset and course provenance

The local dataset is cited as a snapshot with its input hashes retained in `data/study/run.json` [@jobs2026]. Its publisher and full collection coverage have not been independently established. No public dataset DOI is invented.

The user supplied guides from `D:/Repositories/AD688-Web-Analytics`: `M1/M01_Proj.qmd`, `M3/M03_Proj.qmd`, `M4/M04_Proj.qmd` and `M5/M05_Proj.qmd` [@ad688m1; @ad688m3; @ad688m4; @ad688m5]. The M03 file substitutes for the unavailable requested `M3/M02_Proj.qmd`. These are local provenance paths, not public links.

## Verification limits

Publisher records were inspected for the 2018 article, OECD report and scikit-learn paper; the official Census manual was checked for sector 62. The 2017 DOI and conference metadata were found in the author-uploaded publication record. Its DOI endpoint could not be opened by the web tool, so live DOI resolution remains unverified. No missing page range was guessed. The repository's `docs/citation-audit.md` records these checks.

## Complete bibliography

The catalog also preserves the existing `tzimas2024data` record. It is not used to support the five-source review or this revision's findings; its metadata has not been verified in this revision.
